author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Misiorowski (fatigue) to make next start early next week
desc: Jacob Misiorowski is expected to return early next week for the series against the Mets.
impact: Misiorowski was scratched from his last start before the All-Star break due to fatigue. He won't pitch this weekend, but he is slated to make his next start early next week.

author: Nate Miller
title: Aaron Nola delivers solid effort in Thursday's loss
desc: Aaron Nola allowed three runs on six hits and three walks while striking out six across six-plus innings in Thursday's 4-1 loss to the Mets.
impact: If Philadelphia manager Don Mattingly had it to do over again, he'd almost certainly have taken Nola out of this contest after the sixth inning. Nola was excellent through the first half-dozen frames, surrendering just one run on a solo homer while striking out six. However, he gave up two more solo shots to the first two batters he faced in the seventh and left with the Phillies trailing 3-0. Still, after a rollercoaster of a season to this point, Nola came out of the All-Star break with an encouraging performance for the most part. The veteran righty has allowed three runs or less in six of his last seven starts, striking out 40 batters across 37 innings in that span. The home runs remain the main problem for Nola.

author: Nate Miller
title: Trea Turner smacks solo homer in Thursday's loss
desc: Trea Turner went 1-for-4 with a solo homer run in Thursday's 4-1 loss to the Mets.
impact: The Phillies were almost completely blanked on the scoreboard in their first game coming out of the All-Star break. Turner did not let that happen, however, as he launched his 11th homer of the season in the bottom of the eighth inning. The veteran shortstop is still batting just .236 on the season, but he has scored 63 runs to go with 16 steals over 95 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Walbert Urena to start Tuesday
desc: Walbert Urena will start for the Angels on Tuesday against the Cardinals.
impact: Urena posted a stifling 2.88 ERA during the first half of the season. He'll look to carry that momentum into the rest of the year.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Soriano to start Monday
desc: Jose Soriano will start on Monday against the Cardinals.
impact: Soriano will open the second series out of the All-Star break for the Angels. He posted a 3.49 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ronald Acuna Jr. (hamstring) hits grand slam in rehab game
desc: Ronald Acuna Jr. hit a grand slam in his latest rehab game on Thursday.
impact: Acuna was playing in his third rehab game. He should be activated at some point later in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Roldy Brito promoted to High-A
desc: The Rockies promoted Roldy Brito to High-A Spokane.
impact: Brito took part in the Futures Game. He is the No. 3 prospect for Colorado per MLB Pipeline.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cade Marlowe elects free agency
desc: Cade Marlowe has elected free agency.
impact: Marlowe exercised the opt-out clause in his minor league deal with the Athletics. He will figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andre Pallante to start Sunday
desc: Andre Pallante will start on Sunday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: Pallante will close out the first series for the Cardinals out of the All-Star break. He posted a 3.96 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dustin May to start Saturday for Cardinals
desc: Dustin May will start on Saturday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: May was limited his last two starts following an early exit in his first start in July. He should be a full-go heading into the second half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael McGreevy to start Friday
desc: Michael McGreevy is starting for the Cardinals on Friday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: McGreevy will take the mound for St. Louis first out of the All-Star break. He posted a steady 3.01 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Juan Soto suffers calf injury Thursday
desc: Juan Soto left Thursday's game against the Phillies due to left calf soreness.
impact: Soto was removed late in the eighth inning. He is day-to-day going into the weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Bradish to start Sunday
desc: Kyle Bradish will start for the Orioles on Sunday against the Astros.
impact: Bradish will close the first series out of the All-Star break for Baltimore. He posted a strong 3.61 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trevor Rogers to start Saturday
desc: Trevor Rogers will start for the Orioles on Saturday against the Astros.
impact: Rogers has allowed two runs or less in five straight starts. He will look to carry that momentum into the rest of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dean Kremer to start Friday
desc: Dean Kremer will start for the Orioles on Friday against the Astros.
impact: Kremer will take the mound in Baltimore's first game back from the All-Star break. He posted a 4.09 ERA during the first half of the season.
